data.explanation:
REPAIR_REQUIRED — partial08 contains substantive native repairs, but it still has a guaranteed Start-path ReferenceError, incomplete retained-store content integrity, and incomplete snapshot-failure chronology/retention. This is static salvage investigation only against D:/NavSlidesQualification/edu-resume-261004/pending-substrate-candidate-08-partial; it is not admission or runtime qualification. All 15 assigned native helpers were read through their complete source extent, together with the relevant combined-snapshot UI, evidence accumulator, ledger/exposure, live-root observation, canonical activity-clock, and production navigation contracts. No execution, tests, checks, shell, browser, git, edits, installs, or nested agents were used.

Disposition of every finding in the fully read pending-substrate-07-native-admission.json, in its original order (paths below are relative to the frozen root):
1. “N06-N02: Keep Start diagnostics out of lifecycle continuity” — SOURCE-CORRECTED. pending-round-lifecycle-native-history.js:50-63 projects only root-pause/root-resume and relevant document lifecycle events; pending-round-lifecycle-observation-browser.js:87-96 uses the same classification. native-history.js:106-109 retains the native packet and native-action diagnostic rather than deleting it. Complete-store eventSeq still includes diagnostics and other roots; projected histories do not require adjacent sequence numbers.
2. “Declare firstExpiredSample before the witness polling callback” — SOURCE-CORRECTED. pending-round-lifecycle-witness.js:97-100 declares the accumulator; :112-121 assigns and validates it; :129-146 returns lastRunningSample, firstExpiredSample, expiryObservationInterval, activityElapsedInterval, expiredState and expiryTime. This repairs the undeclared-variable defect, not proof that expiry was reached. The separate new Start failure prevents the normal helper journey from reaching this path.
3. “N06-N02: Validate capture-to-post history before adopting Start” — REPAIR_REQUIRED. native-history.js:50-63 now copies each projected event and its primitive-valued lifecycle detail independently for capture and bubble. witness.js:43-59 rejects absent root/document histories and intends to compare both complete prefixes and lengths before baseline adoption. However, its new assertHistoryPrefix calls at :50 and :54 have no import or local declaration. Thus the continuity gate itself throws ReferenceError. Initial running validation remains correctly ordered before promotion at :71-75, but is unreachable through ordinary startWitnessTimer until that binding is fixed.
4. “N06-N03: Bind history health to actual recorder bookkeeping” — PARTIALLY CORRECTED; REPAIR_REQUIRED for content integrity. native-observation.js:24-25 retains the actual array privately; :46-58 checks public identity, private count and full sequence. observation-browser.js:5-17, :61-63, :80-96 and :150-151 consume health on passive, cursor, correlated and extraction paths. Healthy initialized emptiness remains valid, while observable replacement, clearing/truncation, missing/non-array storage and sequence corruption reject. Same-length/same-sequence object or content replacement remains healthy, however; no private original-content record is compared.
5. “N06-N03: Compare complete retained history content” — PARTIALLY CORRECTED; REPAIR_REQUIRED for the full integrity contract. history-domain.js:24-53 now requires eventSeq equality and checks type, tMin/tMax, visibilityState and detail, and witness-domain.js:89-104 consumes those checks without relaxing lengths or completed-pair counts. The comparison still does not compare the recorded event.time field, and it is a witness-baseline comparison rather than a complete-recorder content check. Corruption before baseline capture, passive reads, ordinary correlated clock reads, diagnostics and other-root content are not protected by it. The retained-store finding traces these consumers explicitly rather than inferring integrity from the checker alone.
6. “Retain lifecycle mutations drained at native action boundaries” — SOURCE-CORRECTED. native-history.js:6-7 and :31-40 retain triggerMin/deliveryMax; :53 filters by tMin rather than dropping drained events whose tMax exceeds the earlier boundary; :76-88 and :113-142 drain before history extraction. native-snapshot.js:83-102 and history-domain.js:9-21 use the same tMin inclusion rule for pairs. activity-interval.js:23-35 consumes both uncertainty bounds; no delivery upper bound is clamped away.
7. “N06-N05: Normalize and retain all observed snapshot failures” — PARTIALLY CORRECTED; REPAIR_REQUIRED. observation-errors.js:35-53 forwards all top-level state/UI and capture/post envelopes in state-before-UI, capture-before-post order, and :5-9/:55-56 throws the exact normalized return. observation.js stages raw data before this gate. error-ledger.js:44-64/:76-103 preserves browser cause/domain data, caches envelope normalization and retains actual Node Error identity. Nevertheless, observation-errors.js:13-33 places the later Node document-validation failure ahead of already observed browser getter failures, and observation.js:107-116 can throw on candidate-level recorder/document failure before recording getter failures inside the already staged candidate packets. Both remaining defects are reported separately.
8. “N06-N05: Preserve the recorder exception's actual cause chain” — SOURCE-CORRECTED. native-observation.js:35-44 recursively serializes the real cause chain with browser origin, phase, stack and document/timeOrigin/URL; :89-93 uses it for the actual observer setup exception. error-ledger.js:44-64 recursively materializes those envelopes and :11-42 retains their serialized causes/domain. No runtime cause-chain proof is claimed.
9. “N06-N01: Stage each navigation poll's actual document first” — SOURCE-CORRECTED. navigation.js:85-91 captures slideId, URL, documentId and timeOrigin together; :92-98 stages the full raw poll and contextual poll record before :99-103 validates binding. The offending poll is retained on failure.
10. “N06-N07: Match keyboard eligibility to production dispatch” — SOURCE-CORRECTED for the concrete previously reported focus exclusions and production conditions. navigation.js:37-69 now observes input/textarea/contenteditable, game/action ancestry, configured keyboardCondition and focused-deck status, without forcing focus or changing policy. Canonical shared/src/education/browser/reveal-lifecycle.js:73-83 rejects game/action focus and delegates the prior condition; shared/src/htmlGenerator.js:462-466 excludes summary/video/audio, which is preserved through that configured condition. Limitation: the frozen regular-file subject does not contain Reveal 6.0.2's dependency keyboard-controller implementation; node_modules was not copied. I did not inspect an out-of-subject dependency tree or claim complete external-dispatch certification beyond the concrete focus/production policies evidenced here.
11. “Preserve exact null commands when matching native packets” — SOURCE-CORRECTED. observation-domain.js:60-68 retains full tuple/document/type matching and compares p.command exactly to the cursor command, normalizing only absent cursor command to null. controls.js:44-50, :72-78 and :144-151 still emit change/input actions with actual null commands through native-action.js:7-16.
12. “Reject disconnected current nodes during action extraction” — SOURCE-CORRECTED. observation-browser.js:131-144 captures the actual node.isConnected; observation-domain.js:41-45 rejects disconnection before identity agreement; observation.js:114 consumes that gate before packet acceptance.

Preservation findings: N06-N04 remains source-preserved: witness-domain.js:31-46 checks finite, positive, <=4000 initial remainingMs and :107-126 applies the finite/positive/bounded check to running polls; clock.js:46-57 retains finite due and finite/positive remaining intervals without a fabricated allowance. N06-N06 remains source-preserved: native-action.js:21-40 captures computed CSS visibility plus layout visibility and the actual read interval; :65-73 stages raw guard evidence before document validation. N06-N08 remains preserved by the fully read subject authority: NC11, RPC17, original9 and both historical mapping snapshots retain their original meanings; original7 Hot Potato speed-bonus, original8 Scatter NFC duplicate/unique scoring and original9 full Trivia scoring matrix remain unchanged required other slices.

The supplied partial-freeze and scope-preservation receipts establish 4325 verified baseline copies, 11 changed helper files, 4314 unchanged regular files, all 12 Phase2 callers byte-identical, all 26 helpers below 200 physical lines, no unexpected source additions/deletions, and the unchanged dependency-link target. These are receipt-grounded preservation facts, not a new hash/count check. The Evidence producer receipt exists; the required Native producer receipt is absent and was not fabricated. The immutable acceptance entry and journey callsites still show deferred Page/sink/signature, startRecord/result-consumption and full lifecycle/state/timing cutover obligations; those are intentionally not demanded as already implemented in this helper salvage slice. All 54 acceptance cells and all deferred caller obligations remain open, sourceReady=false, qualification=false, executedAcceptanceCells=0, with no admission permission conferred by this report.

findings.body: The new capture-to-post gate calls assertHistoryPrefix here and again at line 54, but witness.js imports neither that symbol nor a namespace containing it and declares no local binding. The exported implementation exists in history-domain.js and is re-exported by witness-domain.js, but ES-module exports do not become implicit bindings in importers. Every otherwise valid startWitnessTimer invocation reaches this call and throws ReferenceError before adopting its baseline or validating/returning the running witness. Import the existing comparator into this module; fixing firstExpiredSample alone does not make the Start-to-expiry journey usable.
findings.title: Import assertHistoryPrefix before validating the Start bracket

findings.body: __nsCheckStoreHealth accepts any retained event objects whose array identity, length and eventSeq values are unchanged; it retains no independent original content to compare. Replacing a root-pause/root-resume object with another object carrying the same sequence, or changing its finite tMin/tMax/detail before capture, therefore remains healthy. observation-browser.js:5-17 returns that corrupted store from readPassiveEvents, :80-96 forwards the corrupted projections to buildCorrelatedSample, and observation-domain.js:109-135 uses them to derive hidden-time/activity intervals. Native capture/bubble also takes the current contents directly (native-history.js:78-88,133-142). The improved history-domain comparator is consumed only by witness continuity, so it cannot detect corruption before its baseline is captured, cannot protect ordinary clock/getGameState reads, and does not cover diagnostics/other-root contents; even its comparison omits event.time. Bind health to independently retained complete ordered recorder content and validate it before these consumers can convert corrupted histories into clock provenance.
findings.title: N06-N03: Validate complete retained-store content integrity

findings.body: When a browser read contains genuine stateError/uiError envelopes and its observed document also fails binding, those getters have already failed in __nsReadRootSnapshot before the subsequent Node assertDocumentIdentity call. This helper nevertheless records documentIdentity first, then records the getter failures below it. Because record() fixes earliestError to the first normalized return and error-ledger.js fixes primary/order by record arrival, the later document-validation exception becomes the thrown primary and the browser occurrences are serialized in the wrong chronology. Preserve independent document failure, but record the actual already-observed snapshot occurrences before the later validation occurrence, rather than assigning chronology from this fixed category ordering.
findings.title: N06-N05: Preserve snapshot-before-document failure chronology

findings.body: evaluateActionCandidates returns candidate packets containing stateBeforeError/uiBeforeError/stateAfterError/uiAfterError, and this code stages those complete candidates. However, the first assertAndRecordObservationErrors call receives only the outer result: observation-errors.js does not inspect result.candidates. If recorder health is false or the current document fails binding, that gate throws before selecting/staging a packet and before the new packet-level error consumer at line 130 runs. Thus actual getter failures already retained in the raw candidates never reach recordError and are missing from the normalized chronological ledger and exposed failure set. Retain and normalize the relevant packet's actual snapshot siblings alongside the independent extraction-level failures before allowing that outer gate to short-circuit.
findings.title: N06-N05: Retain packet sibling failures before outer rejection
